title: CAS Cell Annotation Collection (local extension)
description: A cell-set-level annotation collection shaped after the Cell Annotation Schema (CAS, general + BICAN) with local extensions: a per-cell-set 'composition' slot (the cell-set-level generalisation of CxG's cell-level descriptor fields), cell_count/cell_ratio on transferred annotations (reused for integration provenance), labelset 'rank'/'role', and a retained 'source' block carrying atlas-paper provenance for the report workflow. See planning/mockup_cas_cxg_annotations_2026-06-24.md.

matrix_file_id.description: Resolvable target for the cell-by-gene matrix: a URL or filename of the h5ad/zarr the annotations describe. Deliberately looser than CAS's namespace:accession form so a plain zarr/h5ad URL or path is valid.

source.description: Local extension: atlas-paper provenance (DOI, subatlas papers, data provenance) consumed by the report workflow. Not part of CAS core.

labelsets.description: Annotation keys. One labelset per cell-type obs column.

annotations.description: Per-cell-set annotations, each tied to a labelset + cell_label.

Labelset.description: A CAS labelset (annotation key). Local extension adds 'role'.

name.description: Name of the annotation key (obs column).

role.description: Local extension: functional role assigned by classify-obs-fields. Free text (open) with recommended values; drives routing, not enumerated as a hard constraint.

Annotation.description: One annotated cell set. Closed set (additionalProperties:false) — arbitrary obs goes in author_annotation_fields, descriptor distributions in composition.

labelset.description: Name of the labelset this annotation belongs to.

cell_label.description: Verbatim author label for the cell set.

cell_set_accession.description: Stable id for this cell set, independent of cell_label.

parent_cell_set_accession.description: Accession of the cell set that subsumes this one (hierarchy).

n_cells.description: Local extension: number of cells in the set.

transferred_annotations.description: CAS slot reused for integration provenance (author labels inherited from contributing datasets). See TransferredAnnotation.

composition.description: Local extension: cell-set-level distributions over descriptor categories (the set-level form of CxG cell-level fields).

author_annotation_fields.description: Arbitrary UNMAPPED obs fields, verbatim. Must not duplicate a labelset or a composition category.

TransferredAnnotation.description: A label transferred from another source. CAS-BICAN shape; local extension adds cell_count/cell_ratio. Reused for integration provenance — the comment should say so.

source_taxonomy.description: PURL/DOI of the source taxonomy or contributing study.

cell_count.description: Local extension: cells in this set carrying the transferred label.

cell_ratio.description: Local extension: fraction of the set carrying the transferred label.

Composition.description: Keyed by CxG descriptor category (tissue, development_stage, assay, disease, sex, self_reported_ethnicity, organism) or an open semantic key (e.g. germ_layer) for non-CxG descriptors. Keys are not enumerated; each value is a CompositionCategory.

CompositionCategory.description: The distribution of one descriptor category over the cell set.

author_field_name.description: The original obs column this category came from.

CompositionValue.description: One value in a descriptor distribution. 'author_value' is verbatim; 'value'/'ontology_term_id' are additive mapped forms. Mirrors CxG's per-field pair, one level up.

author_value.description: Verbatim author value (may already be a CURIE).

ontology_term_id.description: Mapped ontology CURIE, e.g. UBERON:0000966, HsapDv:0000048.

AtlasPaper.description: Atlas publication provenance (retained local block, mirrors cell_type_annotation.schema.json).
